mentions.name: Ferrite
mentions.description: A native Markdown editor built in Rust + egui that also handles JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV. It offers raw, split and WYSIWYG editing modes, wikilinks with a backlinks panel, native Mermaid rendering, and Vim mode. It makes no network calls, stays light with large files, and runs on Windows and Linux (Flathub, AUR, deb/rpm) with experimental macOS support under an MIT license.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ferrite ([github.com/OlaProeis/Ferrite](https://github.com/OlaProeis/Ferrite)), a native Markdown editor I'm building in Rust + egui. It also handles JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV. It has raw, split and WYSIWYG modes, [[wikilinks]] with a backlinks panel, native Mermaid rendering and Vim mode, and it makes no network calls.
